name: prose-matches-grant
body: Agent prose must state only read capabilities the permission grant actually permits. It must never claim the agent may read graph state — the durable spec node files or the transient plan/feedback stores — directly, and it must name the apg tools as the interface that reaches them. Ordinary source files behind code FQNs remain readable with `read`. Complements `domain.constraint.no-internals-in-prose` (which forbids naming the graph-state filesystem paths): this law forbids claiming the access, whether or not a path is named.
